text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to leave the studio after
finishing my
task at hand when I notice
Yukino Bijin practicing
her dancing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeppers! I wanna have a spiffy dance to
show off
at the winn'n concerts too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: 一生懸命で可愛かったぞ
一生懸命で可愛かったよ
choice_data_list_en: You were trying so hard, it was adorable.
You were trying so hard, it was really cute.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But, uh... won't I look kinda plain?
'Specially next
to all the others...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... D-do you know how I can add
some razzle
dazzle t'my concerts?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's a swell idea! You're so right!
What's lack'n
from my danc'n is some
oomph!
choice_data_list: 激しいステップを取り入れてみたら？
アクロバティックな動きをしてみたら？
choice_data_list_en: How about incorporating some intense steps?
Why not try some acrobatic moves?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Being flashy sure is hard...
choice_data_list_en: Looks like some training is in order.
Looks like some training is needed.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Acrobatics... Y'mean like backflips?!
That sounds
pretty tough...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No! I gotta do at least that much if I
wanna be a
real city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I can't b'lieve how embarrass'n
that was!
I'm such a dund'rheeead!
choice_data_list: 見事な転び方だったぞ
見事な転び方だったよ
choice_data_list_en: That was quite a spectacular tumble.
That was quite a spectacular tumble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Half her words are lost in her wail and
the other
half in her heavy accent, but
it's pretty clear that
she's completely
mortified.
